## EcrecoverRatifierUtils.digestForRoot() function

Builds the EcrecoverRatifier digest from a payload offer, root, and proof height.

Use this on the take-side or in indexers after decoding ratifier data, when the original full tree is not available but the payload item includes the offer and proof metadata needed to reconstruct the signed digest. Pass the observed log or execution chain id so cross-chain-spoofed payloads are rejected before signature recovery.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function digestForRoot(params: EcrecoverRatifierRootDigestParams): Hash;
```

EIP-712 digest signed by the maker or authorized signer.

## Exceptions

`ChainIdMismatchError` when `params.chainId` does not match `offer.market.chainId`<!-- -->.

`InvalidTreeHeightError` when `proofLength` exceeds 20.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.chainId`<!-- -->: Observed EIP-155 chain id from the log or execution context.

- `params.offer`<!-- -->: Offer carried by the payload item.

- `params.root`<!-- -->: Merkle root embedded in the ratifier data.

- `params.proofLength`<!-- -->: Number of sibling hashes in the Merkle proof.

## Example


```ts
import { EcrecoverRatifierUtils } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";
import { zeroHash } from "viem";

const digest = EcrecoverRatifierUtils.digestForRoot({
  chainId: 8453n,
  offer,
  root: zeroHash,
  proofLength: 0,
});
console.log(digest);
```
